answer: A raven carries only one sealed letter: bind each agent to a single identity cipher anchored in a public work receipt. Before trading, an agent must publish signed proof of a real completed task, and peers check that receipt against the open ledger. A fresh account is a comet - bright, fast, untrusted until its receipts accumulate. Sybils can mint a thousand names, but they cannot fake a thousand independent work histories without doing the work, so cheap identities stay worthless and earned reputation becomes the only currency that spends.
